desc: A pill that condenses spiritual qi to help Qi Refinement stage cultivators break through bottlenecks (effect lasts 5 years).

desc: A spiritual pill containing the true intent of Foundation Establishment to help Foundation Establishment stage cultivators break through bottlenecks (effect lasts 5 years).

name: Core Formation Breakthrough Pill
desc: Condenses the qi of Core Formation to help Core Formation stage cultivators shatter the core and form the soul (effect lasts 5 years).

name: Qi Refinement Longevity Pill
desc: Refined using common precious herbs

name: Foundation Establishment Longevity Pill
desc: Refined from heavenly and earthly spiritual herbs

name: Core Formation Longevity Pill
desc: Seizes the creation of heaven and earth; mortals die instantly upon consumption

name: Nascent Soul Longevity Pill
desc: Contains a trace of longevity qi

name: Qi Refinement Blood Burning Pill
desc: Burns essence blood in exchange for a short burst of power. Combat power increases within 3 years, but meridians are damaged and combat power decreases within 10 years.

name: Foundation Establishment Blood Burning Pill
desc: A potent medicine to stimulate potential. Combat power increases greatly within 3 years, but weakens within 10 years.

name: Core Formation Blood Burning Pill
desc: The choice for Core Formation cultivators when fighting for their lives. Combat power surges within 3 years, but severe injury within 10 years.

name: Nascent Soul Blood Burning Pill
desc: Burns the Nascent Soul origin. Gains world-destroying power within 3 years, but becomes almost a cripple within 10 years.

name: Qi Refinement Rejuvenation Pill
desc: A common healing pill that can restore the injuries of Qi Refinement stage cultivators (lasts 5 years).

name: Foundation Establishment Rejuvenation Pill
desc: The medicinal power is gentle and mellow

name: Core Formation Rejuvenation Pill
desc: A supreme healing medicine containing the power of vitality (lasts 5 years).

name: Nascent Soul Rejuvenation Pill
desc: Contains the creation of vitality

name: Qi Refinement Beauty-Preserving Pill
desc: Refined from floral dew and spirit herbs, it can slightly improve complexion and appearance (limited to one pill).

name: Foundation Establishment Beauty-Preserving Pill
desc: Its medicinal nature is steadier and can nourish flesh, bones, and vitality over time, making one's appearance stand out more (limited to one pill).

name: Core Formation Beauty-Preserving Pill
desc: Infused with Core Formation spiritual essence, it can preserve one's peak looks for a long time and keep the years from wearing them down easily (limited to one pill).

name: Nascent Soul Beauty-Preserving Pill
desc: Contains a trace of creation qi; taking it can keep one's appearance as though fixed at its most radiant moment (limited to one pill).
